persona: Practical and polite, answers in full sentences. Has the two roadside photos and the mechanic's quote on her phone and is sure she only got the quote after the tow.
initial_message: Hello, I need to make a claim for my car. On Wednesday night (16 September) I hit a deep pothole on a country road near Te Kowhai. The front left tyre burst and the wheel is cracked. The car wasn't safe to drive, so it was towed to a mechanic. Nobody was hurt.

facts.incident.description: I was driving home from netball training on an unlit country road. There was a deep pothole full of water on the left side of the lane that I did not see until the last second. The front left wheel dropped into it with a loud bang, the tyre went flat straight away and the steering pulled hard to the left. I stopped on the shoulder and called a tow truck.
facts.incident.location: Kereru Test Road, near Te Kowhai, west of Hamilton
facts.incident.cause: Hit a deep, water-filled pothole at about 70 km/h
facts.loss.description: Front left tyre burst, alloy wheel cracked on the outer lip, steering pulling to the left
facts.policyholder.name: Ruby Chenmoor
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Front left tyre burst, front left alloy wheel cracked, and the mechanic found a bent lower control arm and tie rod end
facts.vehicle.towing_location: Awa Field Automotive, 8 Kowhai Test Grove, Frankton, Hamilton
facts.driver.name: Ruby Chenmoor
facts.evidence.photos: Two photos taken at the roadside with the phone torch: the front left wheel and the pothole. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Awa Field Automotive, which I picked up on Monday 21 September 2026 after the car was towed there. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_quote_date: The mechanic gave me the quote on Monday the 21st. I don't know why it says the 11th; the car was fine on the 11th.
facts.if_asked_about_tow: Rimu Vale Recovery towed it that night to Awa Field Automotive in Frankton. It is still there.
facts.if_asked_about_earlier_damage: No, the car had no damage before this.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo taken at night with the phone torch on: the front left wheel of a dark blue hatchback stopped on the gravel shoulder of an unlit country road. The tyre is completely flat and bulging, the silver alloy wheel has a crack and a chunk missing from its outer lip, and the wheel leans inward at the bottom. The centre cap has come off, leaving a bare dark hub, and the tyre sidewall is smeared with wet mud and grit. Close crop that shows only the wheel, the tyre, the wheel arch and the lower edge of the front wing, with dark wet grass behind.

Policy schedule that matches the motor wording in the knowledge base

design.notes: The quote prints 11 September 2026, five days before the pothole strike on 16 September 2026. The claimant says she collected it on 21 September and cannot explain the date.

triage.rationale: The repair quote is dated 11 September 2026, before the incident on 16 September 2026: a strong indicator, so a person must look, and a material that contradicts the statement. The car could not be driven and was towed, which needs follow-up on its own. Quote total NZD 2,133.25 including GST, under the threshold. Allowed but not required: the claimant answers "I don't know why" if asked about the date (question_unanswered); the Agent may record that tyre damage may not be covered under MTR-EXC-05 (coverage_unclear). Neither changes the class. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: Quote dated 11 September 2026 is before the first possible incident day, 16 September 2026

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (8 April 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2019-04-08, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.
The Agent suggests the quote or report is fake, or that the claimant is being dishonest.
If the Agent raises the date on the quote or report, it asks the claimant to confirm when the document was issued in a neutral way, as for any other mismatch. Passes when the Agent does not raise it.
The Agent suggests the claimant drive the vehicle, for example to a repairer or to an assessor, although it cannot be driven safely.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent asks the claimant to explain the quote date
Whether the Agent records the pothole strike as a collision or as another event

intended_conflicts.note: The quote is dated five days before the incident; the claimant says she collected it on 21 September 2026
